lore.bio:
Isa Wegner grew up in the midst of Salvo’s infamous underground battle races. Her parents were drivers in Redline, a violent motorcycle battle royale.
When her father died in Redline and left her mother a shell of herself, Axle coped by diving headfirst into Redline, despite her mother’s pleas. Every injury she sustained pushed her to rebuild herself stronger, every scar and mechanical limb a testament to her willingness to push further than anyone else.
Her only competition was a fellow Redline racer called Weaver, a rivalry that caught the eye of Kuben Blisk. He lit the fuse of their rivalry by announcing that the winner of Redline that season would claim an Apex Card–a ticket to the most elite competition in the known universe.
It all came down to the last lap of the final race. In a final desperate gamble, Axle hauled her bike up onto the wall of the track to take the lead from Weaver. But Weaver didn’t back down.
Axle woke up in a hospital, expecting to see Weaver at her bedside. Instead, it was Blisk. “She was a warrior. You are a Legend,” Blisk said, as he flipped her the Apex Card.
In the Games, Axle opens the throttle until she runs out of road–or luck.

For more information on Axle's story, see Axle (character).

passive.name: Drift
passive.description:
Increased control while sliding.

[Patch Apex Legends™: Overclocked Patch Notes - Buff]: Axle's passive ability allows her to accelerate and move faster while sliding, with increased lateral control.

tactical.name: Nitro Gate
tactical.description:
Deploy a speed gate that sends users into a boosted slide.

[Patch Apex Legends™: Overclocked Midseason Patch Notes - Nerf]: Max in-world count reduced and HP reduced. (Max in-world count: 3 -> 2, Hp: 150 -> 100)

[Patch Apex Legends™: Overclocked Patch Notes - Buff]: Axle's Nitro Gate sends users into a boosted slide, with greatly increased velocity and lateral control.

ultimate.name: Kickstart
ultimate.description:
Deploy an enemy-seeking drone that displaces targets on impact.

[Patch Apex Legends™: Overclocked Midseason Patch Notes - Buff]: Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact and enemy highlight duration reduced.

[Patch Apex Legends™: Overclocked Patch Notes - Buff]: Axle's Kickstart drone displaces targets on impact, knocking them back up into the air.

details: [Passive] Buff -> Axle's passive ability allows her to accelerate and move faster while sliding, with increased lateral control.
[Tactical] Buff -> Axle's Nitro Gate sends users into a boosted slide, with greatly increased velocity and lateral control.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Axle's Kickstart drone displaces targets on impact, knocking them back up into the air.
[Tactical] Nerf -> Max in-world count reduced and HP reduced. (Max in-world count: 3 -> 2, Hp: 150 -> 100)
[Passive/tactical] Nerf -> Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate.
[Ultimate] Buff -> Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact and enemy highlight duration reduced.
[Tactical] Adjust -> Reduced max in-world count from 3 to 2.

[Passive/Tactical] Adjust -> Knocked players can no longer slide across zip codes as Axle or while under the effect of a Nitro Gate. They can still boost through a Nitro Gate, but once the effect times out, they will slow down accordingly.
[Upgrades] Adjust -> "Super Slider" Upgrade no longer grants a second Tactical charge. Instead, it now grants Nitro Gate a 5 second cooldown reduction and +1 max in-world count.
[Ultimate] Adjust -> Kickstart now displaces victims on a parabolic arc based on their velocity at the moment of impact, instead of straight up.
Reduced enemy highlight duration slightly to better match stun duration.
